name: AWARE 2.0 — Phase 2.3 Budget Watchdog (Postgres aggregate + tiered soft/hard + rolling 30d)
author: Alfie <alfie@localhost>
goal: Enforce a rolling 30-day LLM cost budget on the AWARE coordinator. Tiered semantics: soft warn at 80% (X-Budget-Tier header on every response), hard stop at 100% (return 402 to /coordinate, expose /budget/status endpoint, coordinator process stays up). Cost source = Postgres aggregate on aware_conversations.cost_total_usd (single source of truth, no double-bookkeeping).
preconditions: Phase 2.1 conversation logger shipped (commit be382b5) — src/db/{index,logger}.js and db/migrations/001_conversations.sql exist and are used in production
Phase 2.2 PRM cache shipped (commit 1b32dd4) — src/db/prm-cache.js and db/migrations/002_prm_cache.sql exist
Architecture decisions (this session): A1 (Postgres aggregate), B3 (tiered soft@80%/hard@100%), C2 (rolling 30 days)
All 135/135 v2 unit tests pass under `node --test 'test/unit/**/*.test.js'` (node:test runner, not jest)

architecture_decisions.kill_semantics: B3 (tiered: soft warn at 80% via X-Budget-Tier response header; hard stop at 100% returns 402 from /coordinate; coordinator process stays up — no launchd flap loop)

config_shape.enabled: AWARE_BUDGET_ENABLED (default true; false → watchdog is a no-op)

steps.name: Pre-flight
steps.expected: Working tree clean; HEAD = 1b32dd4; 135/135 unit tests pass, 0 fail

steps.name: Write migration 003_budget_windows.sql
steps.notes: No schema change to aware_conversations. Add a composite index to make the rolling-window aggregate cheap: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_conv_cost_created ON aware_conversations (created_at, cost_total_usd) WHERE cost_total_usd IS NOT NULL AND ok = true. The partial index keeps it small (only successful requests with a known cost).

steps.name: Write src/budget/watchdog.js
steps.notes: Exports: (1) isEnabled() — reads config.budget.enabled; (2) getWindowSpendUsd() — SELECT COALESCE(SUM(cost_total_usd), 0)::float FROM aware_conversations WHERE created_at > now() - $1::interval AND cost_total_usd IS NOT NULL AND ok = true, bound to `${windowDays} days`; (3) checkBudget() — calls getWindowSpendUsd, computes tier in {ok, soft, hard}, returns {ok, tier, spendUsd, softLimitUsd, hardLimitUsd, windowDays, resetsAt}; (4) getBudgetStatus() — {enabled, ...checkBudget(), lastCheckedAt}; (5) formatResetsAt(windowDays) — Date.now() + windowDays*86400000. ALL DB calls return safe defaults (0 spend, tier='ok') on any error — the watchdog must never break the request path. The watchdog is read-only — no INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE.

steps.name: Wire budget into src/config/index.cjs
steps.notes: Add budget namespace: budget: { enabled: envBool('AWARE_BUDGET_ENABLED', true), windowDays: envInt('AWARE_BUDGET_WINDOW_DAYS', 30, {min: 1, max: 365}), softLimitUsd: envFloat('AWARE_BUDGET_SOFT_LIMIT_USD', 80.0, {min: 0}), hardLimitUsd: envFloat('AWARE_BUDGET_HARD_LIMIT_USD', 100.0, {min: 0}) }. No secrets in this namespace; nothing to add to SECRET_NAMES. Update snapshot-stability test to expect 7 top-level keys (was 6: config, db, gateway, heavySkill, logging, prmCache — add budget).

steps.name: Wire budget into src/coordinator/http-server.js
steps.notes: (1) Import checkBudget, getBudgetStatus, isEnabled from src/budget/watchdog.js. (2) In handleCoordinate, BEFORE T2 per-request cap, call checkBudget(); if hard → return 402 with body {error: 'budget_exhausted', spendUsd, hardLimitUsd, resetsAt}; if soft or ok → continue and set res.setHeader('X-Budget-Tier', tier). (3) Add new route GET /budget/status → 200 with body = getBudgetStatus(). (4) All budget calls are synchronous; the watchdog DB call is awaited at the top of the request (only one query per /coordinate). (5) On watchdog DB error, log a warn and treat as tier=ok (fail-open — never block requests because the budget DB is sad).

steps.name: Write test/unit/budget/watchdog.test.js
steps.notes: Tests: (1) isEnabled() reads config.budget.enabled. (2) getWindowSpendUsd() with mocked pool returns the float sum. (3) getWindowSpendUsd() returns 0 on empty result. (4) getWindowSpendUsd() returns 0 on pool error (fail-open). (5) checkBudget() with spend=0, soft=80, hard=100 → tier=ok. (6) checkBudget() with spend=85, soft=80, hard=100 → tier=soft. (7) checkBudget() with spend=100.01, soft=80, hard=100 → tier=hard. (8) checkBudget() returns {spendUsd, softLimitUsd, hardLimitUsd, windowDays, resetsAt}. (9) getBudgetStatus() includes enabled flag. (10) checkBudget() with disabled config short-circuits to tier=ok. (11) checkBudget() with windowDays=7, resetsAt ≈ now+7d. (12) formatResetsAt returns ISO string. (13) query uses parameterized interval (no SQL injection). (14) query filters ok=true. (15) all DB calls wrapped in try/catch returning safe defaults. Uses node:test, async fns. Mocks the pool from src/db/index.js with a fake .query() that returns {rows: [{sum: '85.42'}]} or throws.

(3) AWARE_BUDGET_WINDOW_DAYS=7 → windowDays=7. (4) AWARE_BUDGET_HARD_LIMIT_USD=250.50 → hardLimitUsd=250.50. (5) snapshot key list now includes 'budget' (so it joins the other 6).
